maya: good morning — quick async standup.
What I did: onboarded spanish-promptset v2 to staging, ran 200-sample evals against llama3-smallq.
Blockers: saw a ~6% drop in politeness score on paraphrase set compared to v1. looks prompt-related but could be kv-warmup/batching. opened TKT-789.
Today: triage root cause, iterate prompt tweaks, and request someone to review my batching change PR and run a staging smoke. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321 (batching+kv minor tweak). cc @sam @liam :eyes:

sam: saw the eval diffs — reproduced locally with the small harness. Kv-cache seems cold for some prefixes, which can change output ordering w/ the new prompt. adding a unit test.
Quick repro command I used:
```
python tools/eval_harness.py --model llama3-smallq --prompt-set spanish-promptset-v2 --seed 42 --limit 200
```
I'll comment on the PR with a failing example.

liam: I can take prompt review after lunch. fyi I spotted one tokenization oddity in prompt_templates/es/convo_v2.tpl — might explain tone shift.

olivia: I can review prompts now (10–15m). which file should I look at?
maya: @olivia the main ones are `prompt_templates/es/convo_v2.tpl` and `prompt_sets/spanish-v2.yaml`.

jordan: re: PR 4321 — left a couple small nits (style + one concurrency comment). none seem blocking. I can run smoke on dedicated-staging pool after the merge, ETA 14:00 PT. :thumbsup:

chris: kicking off targeted smoke run on staging-dedicated-3 now. will post quick metrics.

iris-bot: smoke-test: staging-dedicated-3 — run 2798765438 — status: in_progress
iris-bot: smoke-test: staging-dedicated-3 — run 2798765445 — status: passed 
metrics: p95 latency 220ms, token-cost delta +0.4%, sample-quality checks ok (except paraphrase politeness flagged).

maya: thanks all. tagging TKT-789 as blocker->investigating and adding PR link.
sam: note — if kv-warmup is root cause, we should try prefix caching in the serving config and rerun the evals. I can prototype a quick patch today.

olivia: doing prompt tweak now, pushing a small phrasing change to reduce directive phrasing. will link a PR in a bit.

liam: if anyone needs me for prompt A/B eval infra, ping — I can spin a 1k-sample async job.

maya: sweet. action items: 1) olivia prompt PR, 2) sam kv test + prototype, 3) jordan merge+smoke, 4) liam optional A/B run. i'll follow up with a short eval once prompt PR lands. thanks! :heart:
